# Stock Creality CR-10 S5: reference model (generated by build_s5_stock.py)

Not measured from a whole S5: jdub1981's CR-10 S4 model stretched to the S5's measured extrusion lengths, plus the S5 bed from Quasiiso's CNC drawing. Use it for layout and clearances, not for machining. *(est.)* = not measured.

| Item | Model (mm) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Uprights 2040 | [650.0] | S5 measured 650 |
| Base sides 2040 | [690.0] | S5 measured 690 |
| Cross members, top bar 2020 | [620.0, 620.0] | S5 measured 3 × 620 |
| X gantry 2020 (above the bed) | [635.0] | *(est.: top bar + 15, as on the official CR-10, 400 / 415)* |
| Y rails 2040 | [730.0] | *(est.: base sides + the two 20 mm cross members, as on the S4: 558.8 + 40 = 598.8)* |
| Z lead screws | [608.5] | *(est.; the official CR-10's is upright − 36 (514), which gives 614; another builder measured 650)* |
| Bed plate | 509.6 × 509.6 × 3.2 | CNC drawing |
| Levelling screws | 340.4 × 340.4 | CNC drawing (S4 model springs: 339.9) |
| Bed frame 2020 | bar centres 419.6 × 419.6, outer 439.6 | CNC drawing (screws 45 mm in) |
| Overall (all parts) | 695 × 808 × 690 (x × y × z) | Creality: frame 690 × 800 × 715 |
| Extrusion frame only | 635 × 730 × 690 | |

## Extrusions on the stock S5

x: left → right, y: front → back, z: up (origin: the S4 model's). Where: its place on the printer.

| Part | Profile | Length (mm) | Qty | Runs | Where | Centre x, y, z (mm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| upright 2040 | 2040 | 650.0 | 2 | up | standing at each side, mid-depth on the base sides | 780, 28, 363; 200, 28, 363 |
| base side 2040 | 2040 | 690.0 | 2 | front–back | the two outer base rails, front to back, on the floor, between the front and back cross members | 200, -8, 28; 780, -8, 28 |
| cross member 2020 (front) | 2020 | 620.0 | 1 | left–right | base, front end, full width; the base sides butt into it | 490, -363, 28 |
| cross member 2020 (back) | 2020 | 620.0 | 1 | left–right | base, back end, full width; the base sides butt into it | 490, 347, 28 |
| Y rail 2040 | 2040 | 730.0 | 2 | front–back | the two centre rails on top of the cross members, full depth (690 + 2 × 20); the bed's V-wheels run on them | 623, -8, 48; 358, -8, 48 |
| top bar 2020 | 2020 | 620.0 | 1 | left–right | across the tops of the uprights | 490, 28, 698 |
| X gantry 2020 | 2020 | 635.0 | 1 | left–right | across the uprights on the Z carriages; carries the hotend | 491, 2, 192 |
| bed frame 2020 (front/back) | 2020 | 439.6 | 2 | left–right | under the bed plate, front and back, bolted square | 489, -216, 78; 489, 203, 78 |
| bed frame 2020 (side) | 2020 | 399.6 | 2 | front–back | under the bed plate, left and right, between the front/back bars | 279, -7, 78; 699, -7, 78 |

Parts: X end plate × 1, X gantry 2020 × 1, Y belt × 1, Y carriage plate × 1, Y motor + bracket × 1, Y rail 2040 × 2, Z coupler × 2, Z lead screw × 2, Z motor (NEMA17) × 2, Z motor plate × 1, base side 2040 × 2, bed frame 2020 (front/back) × 2, bed frame 2020 (side) × 2, bed plate 509.6 (S5) × 1, bed screw × 4, bed spring × 4, cross member 2020 (back) × 1, cross member 2020 (front) × 1, heater pad 508 × 1, hotend carriage × 1, hotend carriage plate × 1, top bar 2020 × 1, top corner bracket × 2, upright 2040 × 2; plus 63 small parts and hardware from the S4 model.

Sources: [CR-10 S4 model, jdub1981, Thingiverse 2565204 (CC BY)](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2565204); [CR-10 S5 aluminium bed, Quasiiso, Thingiverse 2816166 (CC BY-NC)](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2816166); S5 extrusion lengths: research/README.md; bed: research/BED-HOLES.md.
